python.note: The verified reference interpreter was CPython 3.10.21 (conda-forge, macOS). The newest Linux x86_64 CPython 3.10 build available through uv is 3.10.20, used for Linux instantiation. The validator requires the 3.10 series and records the exact micro version in provenance.

cpu.purpose: official tests, CPU validation and native CPU producers

cu121.driver_requirement: NVIDIA driver supporting CUDA 12.1 or newer (server: 550.54.14 / CUDA 12.4)
cu121.purpose: official GPU training and scientific runs

primary_reference.description: Runtime-hardening reference environment: full suite 898 tests verified on Python 3.10.21 / torch 2.4.1 / NumPy 1.26.4; scikit-image 0.24.0 installed into that environment; target server Python 3.10, torch 2.4.1, CUDA 12.1.

pins.torch 2.4.1: runtime_review.md, astra_final_report.md, runtime_runbook.md, self_audit_maskfree/runtime.py ('target environment is torch 2.4.1')
pins.numpy 1.26.4: runtime_review.md, astra_final_report.md; environment.yaml numpy=1.26.4; CUTS candidate numpy=1.26.4
pins.torchvision 0.19.1: release paired with torch 2.4.1; the resolver accepts it with torch==2.4.1 (torchvision 0.19.1 metadata requires torch==2.4.1)
pins.psutil, wandb and all transitive package: no repository pin; resolver selection recorded in the locks (not numerically critical)

regeneration: environments/compile_locks.sh (uv pip compile, hashes, Linux x86_64, CPython 3.10)
portability_only_environments: Other interpreters (for example NumPy 1.24 / Python 3.8, or NumPy 2.x / Python 3.12) may run regression/portability tests only; they are never official experiment environments.
